name: CION Investment (CION)
teaser: At $6.36 the shares trade 9.3% below my Base value of $7.01, an upside of 10.3%, but that Base is a blend of two methods that disagree by 60%. The earnings method gives $5.99, below the price. The asset method gives $11.12, and the shares trade at 0.47 times reported net asset value, a 53% discount. CION pays $1.20 a year, an 18.9% yield, but in the second quarter net investment income covered 95.5% of the distribution and 24.7% of total income was paid in kind, not in cash. Confidence is D and the required margin of safety is 50%, which gives an indicative cap of $3.51 and no buy zone. Hold for holders, watchlist for new money. Third quarter results on November 5 are not in this analysis.
llms: Externally managed business development company lending to middle-market companies, valued on economic income, distributions and a justified price to net asset value with a stressed realizable NAV cross-check; the two methods differ by 60 percent and a quarter of income is paid in kind. Bear 3.50, Base 7.01, Bull 9.69. Verdict HOLD at 6.36 (watchlist, no buy zone).
